name: Gomorrah: The Origins
description: The series Gomorrah - The Origins explores Pietro Savastano's youth in the 1970s, in a Naples undergoing a transformation, poverty-stricken and plagued by cigarette smuggling. The story begins in 1977 with a very young Pietro, the son of no one, growing up as an adoptive brother in a family in the poorest part of Secondigliano. A street kid, he scrapes by as best he can, dreaming of a well-being that is still denied him. The story unfolds through Pietro's loss of innocence, along with his brothers and lifelong friends, their ambitions, and his first great love, which, like that of every teenager, will be wild and passionate. His encounter with Angelo, known as 'A Sirena,' the regent of Secondigliano, marks his entry into the world of crime. Through violence, alliances, and betrayals, Pietro discovers the price that life takes.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Pietro dreams of becoming like his idol, Angelo ‘A Sirena, but after a night spent by his side, he discovers that all dreams come at a price.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Angelo receives an invitation that could improve his situation, while Pietro comes face to face with reality and realizes that dreams aren't for everyone.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Angelo is forced to accept a deal and enlists Pietro's help to implement it. But not everything is as it seems.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Angelo is in grave danger, and Pietro knows he can't abandon him. Just as Imma knows she must help her friend Annalisa, no matter the cost.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Pietro and Imma come to terms with what happened the night before. While Angelo seems to have finally gotten everything he wants.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Angelo suffers a heavy blow and even though he says he doesn't want revenge, only Pietro understands what he really has in mind.
